invariants.rationale: The result is always a non-null List due to the collect operation.
The filter(Objects::nonNull) operation ensures no null elements are present in the result.
The output list has at most as many elements as there are unique keys in the input data.
Because each output value represents a grouping of one or more input elements, but never more than the total input size.
Parallelism is used for the parallel stream operation and is expected to be positive.
